commandmentsBaseline.changeReview: Reviewed the complete upstream delta. Brick Contract 1.22.1 adds catalogue-only installation routing and release-matched practical recipes. Published upstream recipes and executable tests were preserved, declared, compiled and re-exercised in this combined delivery; the original seventeen findings and corrections remain applicable. Other selected subject rules are unchanged.

findings.title: Public classes still lack meaningful XML descriptions
Public methods have incomplete XML summaries and parameter/return contracts

unverified: Physical keyboard/mouse, alternate skin, high-DPI and device acceptance were not performed. Native dark-skin Inspector captures are scoped to the recorded panels and widths.

Windows batch players validate APIs, persistence and ordinary bootstrap ownership. They do not certify visual console layout, physical input, audible output, native Steam sessions or every product capability.
FMOD has separately recorded real licensed compilation and native NOSOUND_NRT checks. Audible/device acceptance and unchanged vendor RuntimeManager behavior remain outside this correction.
Real paid model naming accuracy was not tested. Synthetic audio/filtering and controlled late/cancelled request tests do not certify semantic naming accuracy.
BigBang remains exempt from dependency compliance and dependency-driven changes. Consumer installation is manual; unfinished SaveLoad and Steam features were not implemented.
